sources.title: A.J. Brown trade rumors: Rams and Broncos interested in Eagles wide receiver
sources.description: Late last week, there seemed to be a sense that an A.J. Brown trade was going to go down. It didn’t. But that doesn’t necessarily mean the wide receiver is staying in Philadelphia to play for the Eagles this season. The latest buzz on the Brown trade front comes from who else but NFL insider […]
